candidate_identity.paper_title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents

published_claim.primary_abstract_supported: MindSkillEvolve improves SpreadsheetBench success by 9.2 percentage points over the initial-skill baseline.

found.observation: Concrete initial xlsx skill is published at the pinned commit.
Runner exposes SpreadsheetBench, baseline/evolution paths, --evolve, --evolve-every, seed/limit/concurrency plumbing, per-case trajectories, evolution events, and summary output.
Code pins a public SpreadsheetBench Verified-400 archive URL and default shuffle seed 1447; model, temperature, max turns, and evolution endpoint are configurable.
Downloads/extracts spreadsheetbench_verified_400 and resolves dataset.json with path-traversal-safe extraction.
Publishes value-normalization and answer-position workbook comparison used for scoring.
Repository includes unit/integration-style tests for scoring semantics, case loading, deterministic seed shuffling, baseline concurrency, and evolution-batch lifecycle.

official_artifact_support.important_execution_detail: The generic public runner can execute a real evolution path only when an evolution service URL is supplied; --evolve without --evolution-base-url explicitly falls back to a no-op evolver.

assessment.rationale: The public project contains materially more than paper-only code: a concrete initial skill, Verified-400 downloader, benchmark environment, scoring code, evolution-aware runner, trajectories/events, and tests. That is enough to support implementation plausibility and a practical rerun attempt. However, the inspected artifacts do not bind the published 57.2% +/- 2.4% result to a complete immutable experiment manifest with exact model/service configurations, batch schedule, three repeat seeds, and raw outputs, and no independent numerical rerun was found. Therefore the published improvement remains author-reported rather than independently reproduced.
assessment.scope_guard: This assessment applies only to the pinned MindSkillEvolve SpreadsheetBench-Verified result and inspected public artifact path. It does not assess all MindMemOS memory benchmarks, prove or disprove the whole system, or infer the existence/absence of unpublished validation wrappers.

safe_to_treat_as: author-reported quantitative evidence backed by a substantial official executable artifact
evidence that an online trajectory-to-skill evolution path is implemented publicly
a candidate suitable for an independent numerical rerun
not_safe_to_treat_as: proof that the exact published table is reproducible from repository defaults alone
evidence for a held-out behavioral acceptance gate between generated skill patch and promotion

exact_next_action: Attempt a source-pinned independent rerun only after recovering the paper experiment's exact model/provider bindings, three-run seed schedule, evolution batch size/round schedule, evolution-service configuration, and raw-result provenance. If those cannot be recovered, run a clearly labeled adaptation using the pinned public harness and report it as a new configuration rather than a reproduction of 57.2%.
